result:
The DE Operating account (GL 1000) bank reconciliation for March is complete. Summary of what was found and done:

**Root causes of the book-vs-bank variance (EUR 14,908.50 initially):**

1. **Duplicate AP payment (booked correction)** – JE-00272 and JE-00273 both paid Rheinbyte Software's single €6,480 invoice (RB-2026-0318); only one SEPA transfer actually cleared the bank. Reversed the duplicate (JE-00273 → JE-00309), supported by the vendor invoice and bank statement.

2. **Unrecorded bank service charge (booked correction)** – €38.50 monthly fee on the statement wasn't in the ledger. Posted JE-00310 to Bank Fees (6900), supported by the bank statement.

3. **Deposit in transit (no entry needed)** – The €18,200 Kessler AG receipt (JE-00308) was correctly booked but the SEPA transfer was initiated after bank cutoff per the remittance advice — a normal timing difference that will clear in April.

4. **Unidentified €3,150 outgoing wire (flagged, not booked)** – Bank line BT-DE-0045 ("SEPA OUT REF TX-44817") has no matching vendor bill, contract, or remittance advice anywhere in the records. Since it can't be supported, I did not force a book entry — logged as exception EXC-001 for controller/treasury to trace with the bank.

All other 17 lines matched cleanly 1:1 and were tied out. The checklist item was marked **blocked** (not complete) since one item still requires investigation before final sign-off, and a memo was submitted to the controller with full detail.
